a.lede: Reddit is testing ads on another area of its platform: search. With this update, ads will appear within your search results "based on a range of factors, including contextual relevance to a search query," according to Reddit. a.title: Reddit is adding more ads

b.lede: The new ad placements could help Reddit squeeze more revenue from existing users as Google's AI search changes how people discover its content.
b.title: Reddit tests ads in search results as traffic declines and growth concerns mount
